detail: FSSAI Advertising & Claims Regulations 2018, Schedule I (Protein): 'Source of protein' needs >=10% RDA per 100 g (solids) or 5% RDA per 100 kcal; 'High/Rich in protein' needs >=20% RDA per 100 g or 10% RDA per 100 kcal.

detail: Front-of-pack warning labels ('HIGH SUGAR/FAT/SALT') proposed by FSSAI under Supreme Court pressure (Aug 2026); sugar-heavy dessert mixes may need a red warning - formulate low-sugar.

item: 'Gluten-free' and 'eggless'/veg (green dot) claims require compliance with FSSAI
detail: 'Gluten-free' and 'eggless'/veg (green dot) claims require compliance with FSSAI labelling; gluten-free claim needs testing (specific threshold not verified in this research).

Texture is the #1 product risk: 'dry', 'chewy', 'rubbery/sponge', 'dries like a rock' recur for both Indian protein snacks (SuperYou killed a bar over chewiness) and protein mug cakes. Lead R&D on moistness (fat/fibre/humectants) and test all 4 appliances.

Taste beats protein: brands and scientists alike say Indians reject 'powdery/chalky' protein; artificial/over-sweet flavour is a frequent complaint. 'No protein aftertaste' is a credible claim worth earning.
Price sensitivity is real: only ~32% will pay a protein premium; affordability is the top barrier. Singles must feel like an impulse treat (likely Rs 50-80 band); validate via survey.

Trust/labels is a headwind and an opening: 'protein washing' and lab tests showing ~70% of supplements under-deliver protein make transparency (clean label, third-party protein test, honest sugar) a differentiator; 62% rank ingredient transparency first.

Convenience is the strongest positive driver (41% of social conversation); '2 minutes', 'easy' are praised. One-sachet, no-measuring format fits — reviewers note results depend on exact quantities, so premeasured single serves are an advantage.
Health-halo skepticism is growing among nutritionists/columnists ('protein cookies aren't the solution'); position as a better dessert swap / guilt-free craving fix, not a health food or supplement.

Gap: direct Reddit threads could not be fetched (site blocked; search engines did not index them). Reddit sentiment is represented only via the Convosight aggregate — run the outreach posts to collect first-hand r/fitnessindia voices.

Context: air fryer sales grew ~38% YoY (Croma 2025) — air fryer + microwave instructions are both necessary; eggless is table stakes for a large vegetarian base (not directly quantified in sources found).

item: FSSAI notices over protein / muscle-strength claims (Oct 2026)
detail: FSSAI sent notices to Dr Reddy's, Nestlé Health Science, Amazon, Flipkart, Netmeds and Tirupati Wellness over 'high protein' / 'muscle strength' marketing claims that may mislead; asked them to explain the claims (reported 8 Oct 2026). Enforcement on protein claims is active, including against marketplaces.

FSSAI told the Supreme Court (affidavit 23 Sep 2026) it will bring red-hexagon front-of-pack warnings in a single phase: covers added/total sugar, added/total fat and salt; solid-food thresholds ~5% energy from added sugar, 10% total sugar, ~15% added fat, 30% total fat. Draft regs (~4 months, 60-day comment) then 365-day implementation. Still proposed, not final.
